# Kenney Input Prompts

The fonts of Kenney's Input Prompts 1.5 (https://kenney.nl/assets/input-prompts), as released: CC0 (License.txt).
nx2/prompt_assets.py draws the game's button icons for other controllers from them.

- kenney_input_xbox_series.otf (Xbox Series/Fonts)
- kenney_input_playstation_series.otf (PlayStation Series/Fonts)
- kenney_input_steam_deck.otf (Steam Deck/Fonts)
